name: Apply PR416 ApplyKick height ablation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-applykick-height-ablation
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/apply-pr416-applykick-height-ablation.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  patch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-applykick-height-ablation
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply isolated ApplyKick height ablation
        run: python3 tools/apply_pr416_applykick_height_ablation.py

      - name: Remove one-shot helpers and commit evidence arm
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git rm .github/workflows/apply-pr416-applykick-height-ablation.yml tools/apply_pr416_applykick_height_ablation.py
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git add src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs
          git commit -m "chore(evidence): ablate ApplyKick height promotion"
          git push origin HEAD:evidence/pr416-applykick-height-ablation
